name: Nozdormu's Gaze reduces Time Out!'s mana per tick, not its damage reduction (#3690)
contract: Nozdormu's Gaze 807691's tooltip is "Your Time Out! now regenerates $s1% less mana per tick, but casting it now instantly restores an additional $504838s1% of your maximum mana". Time Out!'s own description is "Enter a stasis for $802228d, instantly restoring $s3% of your maximum mana and regenerating $s2% of your maximum mana every $/1000;T2 sec. While active, your damage taken is reduced by $s1%", so the mana per tick is Time Out!'s $s2, effect index 1 (Aura=24 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_ENERGIZE, EffectAmplitude 500), while $s1 is effect index 0 (the damage reduction, -50/-75/-90 across ranks 802229/803896/803897). 807691's effect 0 is Aura=107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) with EffectBasePoints -3 and EffectDieSides 1, so a flat -2, EffectSpellClassMask [32768,0,0] which selects exactly the three Time Out! ranks, and EffectMiscValue 3 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT1. Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers (Unit.cpp:12072-12083) maps SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 to effect index 0, SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (12) to index 1 and SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 (23) to index 2, so the record as shipped moves the damage reduction instead of the mana regeneration. The spell_modifier metric applies the player's native modifiers without submitting a cast and without spending charges, so the two ops can be read separately. The talented reading must be -2 on op 12 and 0 on op 3; the untalented control must be 0 on both.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Without the talent Time Out!'s damage reduction carries no flat modifier
Without the talent Time Out!'s mana per tick carries no flat modifier
Nozdormu's Gaze adds -2 to Time Out!'s mana regenerated per tick
Nozdormu's Gaze leaves Time Out!'s damage reduction untouched
